bull.narrative: MP Materials Corp achieves commercial-scale production and becomes a leading player in the rare-earth mining industry, driven by growing demand for rare earth elements and successful advancement of the rare earth value chain.

base.narrative: MP Materials Corp makes steady progress in advancing the rare earth value chain, but faces challenges in achieving commercial-scale production, resulting in moderate growth.

bear.narrative: MP Materials Corp fails to secure additional funding and advance the rare earth value chain, leading to significant decline in market value.

tracking_note: Monitoring progress towards commercial-scale production and rare earth value chain advancement.
thesis_breaks_if: Failure to achieve commercial-scale production within the next 5 years
